**TypeAssist 1.6.1**: offline autocorrect and word prediction for **Persian and English** in every Windows app.

### Fixed
- **Real words are no longer switched to the other language.** A word is only retyped in the other language when what you typed is clear gibberish. Words that mean something in both languages stay as typed (`بعد` is no longer turned into `fun`, `مثلا` is left alone).
- **Undo now sticks.** Pressing Backspace right after a keyboard-language fix blocks that switch for good, in both directions.
- **Apps that don't follow keyboard switching are left alone.** If an app ignores the keyboard switch or delivers finished characters instead of keys, TypeAssist stops retyping words in that app, because it can't be sure what is on screen there.

In a simulation of about 93,000 correctly typed English and Persian words, no word was switched by mistake.

### Upgrading
1. Right-click the tray icon → **Exit**.
2. Download `TypeAssist-1.6.1.zip` below; before extracting, right-click → Properties → tick **Unblock**.
3. Run `TypeAssist.exe`. Your learned words carry over. If **Start with Windows** is on, the installed copy updates itself.

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/mkovich/TypeAssist/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
